hook: Raat ke do baje cab ki driver seat bilkul khaali thi...
feedback: Solid twist and strong emotional core. To hit perfection: 1) Cut 10 is silent—ensure the visual shift (I5 to I4) builds maximum visual panic. 2) The transition into the flashback hook in Cut 3 works well, but make sure the line rhythm in cuts 4-5 gives a tiny bit more warm character grounding for Meher (e.g., mention her exhausted shift) so the audience connects with her vulnerability even faster before the SUV chase starts. REPEATS: an image is reused too often or twice in a row; use new inserts (hands, eyes, lantern, a clue) instead.
lines: Raat ke do baje cab ki driver seat bilkul khaali thi...
aur dashboard par rakha tha wahi purana keychain!
Par ye sab shuru hua jab Meher ka phone dead hua...
Raat ke do-tees baje Gurgaon highway par Meher akeli khadi thi.
Akeli ladki, sunsaan sarak aur zero network.
Tabhi ek kaali cab aakar ruki. Driver ne apna chehra hood se chhipa rakha tha.
Usne bas itna kaha, 'Baitho beta, PG chhod deta hoon.'
Raste me ek badi SUV unka pechha karne lagi.
Meher ka dil zor se dhadakne laga.
Par driver ne gaadi speed me dauda kar, Meher ko dhal ban kar bachaya.
Kuchh hi der me cab safe PG gate ke bahar ruki.
Meher ne mud kar dekha... toh seat bilkul khaali thi!
Aur dashboard par rakha tha wahi metal keychain...
jo usne pichhle mahine accident me maare gaye apne bade bhai ke saath dafnaya tha.
